rule_or_pattern: Drop lines flagged C:cph_out_of_range, C:cpp_vs_book_out or C:len_vs_book_high (mostly the small-print epigram/footnote page p000072 and footnotes, where the crop shows one print line but the label is another line or runs on into the next line).
notes: The verse body reads correctly (1-18, 24, 31, 38, 40); repeated 'Τσιγκάνα Τσιγκάνα', 'φροὺ φροὺ' and the running heads 'ΛΟΓΗΣ ΛΟΓΗΣ' / 'ΤΑΜΠΟΥΡΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΚΟΠΑΝΟΣ' are really printed, and the final-sigma hits are elisions (δῶσ᾽, ἄσ᾽). The bad subset is small-print lines: 20 (crop is the footnote '** Ἡ κ. Στεφανόπωλη...', label 'Ψυχάρη καὶ τοὺς πατριῶτες'), 32 and 37 (label from a different line), and 21, 26, 29 (label continues with words from the next line, e.g. '...νὰ βγάζουν καὶ τῆρα'). The flag rule also drops a few correct headings, which is acceptable.
